text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

text.zh-TW: 你推薦的朋友可由 Hosting.com 免費搬遷網站。取自平台分享文案；實際條件以官方公告為準。
text.en: A referred friend's site is migrated for free. From the platform's share text; actual conditions follow the official announcements.

text.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有說明回饋的內容與金額，以 Hosting.com 官方公告為準。
text.en: The share text does not say what the reward is or how much; Hosting.com's official announcements prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會在新分頁開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it opens in a new tab).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示選擇主機方案並註冊。
steps.en: Choose a hosting plan and register as the page directs.

steps.zh-TW: 依活動規則取得 $20 折扣與免費網站搬遷。
steps.en: Receive the $20 discount and the free website migration under the campaign rules.

intro.zh-TW: Hosting.com 網站主機推薦：好友透過連結註冊可享 $20 折扣，並可免費搬遷網站；推薦人也會獲得回饋。
intro.en: Hosting.com referral: your friend gets $20 off and a free website migration, and you receive a reward as a thank-you.

description.zh-TW:
Hosting.com 是提供網站主機服務的供應商，網站經營者可以在上面選購主機方案來放置自己的網站。這是推薦人專屬的邀請連結，沒有另外的邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結註冊。

依分享文案，你推薦的朋友可享 $20 折扣，並由 Hosting.com 免費搬遷網站；推薦人則會收到回饋。實際金額、條件與期限以 Hosting.com 官方公告為準。
description.en:
Hosting.com is a web hosting provider where site owners can choose a hosting plan for their website. This is the referrer's personal link and there is no separate code to type, so register through the link on this page.

According to the share text, a friend you refer gets $20 off and Hosting.com migrates their site for free, while the referrer receives a reward. Actual amounts, conditions and deadlines follow Hosting.com's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 這是推薦人專屬連結（網址內含推薦人識別碼），沒有可手動輸入的短碼，請直接透過連結註冊。優惠內容取自分享文案，實際條件與期限以 Hosting.com 官方公告為準。
notes.en: This is the referrer's personal link (its address carries the referrer's identifier) with no short code to type in, so sign up through the link itself. The offer comes from the share text; actual conditions and deadlines follow Hosting.com's official announcements.
